BundleRequest.description:
Build a bundle: controller file + optional params + car config (spec 0012).

``race`` (spec 0030): a race-mode bundle — arms only when every radio is off, no live view or
teleop, no test speed limit.
BundleRequest.title: BundleRequest

CarPairingRequest.description: Car address + token to hand to TrackScout's drive mode (spec 0010 C).
CarPairingRequest.title: CarPairingRequest

ConnectorDef.description: A connector in the part's own frame (core frame, metres).
ConnectorDef.title: ConnectorDef

ConstructLimits.description: Size/weight limits from the race rules; empty until the teacher defines them.
ConstructLimits.title: ConstructLimits

EditOp.description: One edit; ``none`` only evaluates. Moves and turns use world axes (m, quarter turns).
EditOp.title: EditOp

FloorplanResponse.description: Car-height occupancy of a scan pass as an image (row 0 = highest y), to draw tracks on.
FloorplanResponse.title: FloorplanResponse

InboxAction.description: Team tab choice for a pass that waits on this laptop (spec 0007 scope 9).
InboxAction.title: InboxAction

InstallResult.description: What the board's installer reports (one JSON line; ``result.json`` on a USB stick).
InstallResult.title: InstallResult

LDrawPart.description: A part of the LDraw library that is not in the catalogue yet (spec 0018).
LDrawPart.title: LDrawPart

LocalPartRequest.description:
Add an LDraw part to the team's local catalogue (unverified). Holes/length create the
standard pin-hole / pin-or-axle connectors like the curated beams, pins and axles.
LocalPartRequest.title: LocalPartRequest

LocalWorkerUpdate.description: Switch this computer's team worker on/off and set when it takes jobs (spec 0020 C).
LocalWorkerUpdate.title: LocalWorkerUpdate

PrintedImportRequest.description: Import a 3D-printed part (spec 0019) from a mesh file on this computer.
PrintedImportRequest.title: PrintedImportRequest

QuickStartParams.description: Inputs of the quick-start generator (spec 0002); invalid values list valid ones.
QuickStartParams.title: QuickStartParams

QuickTrack.description: What the user draws: centreline points (m), one corridor width, loop or point-to-point.
QuickTrack.title: QuickTrack

QuickTrackPreview.description: 2D view of a drawn track as the simulator will build it (or why it cannot).
QuickTrackPreview.title: QuickTrackPreview

RaceResult.description: One race timed in Race Control: start signal time, laps per car, incidents, standings.
RaceResult.title: RaceResult

RaceSetupEdit.description: Missing fields fall back to the automatic values of spec 0014.
RaceSetupEdit.title: RaceSetupEdit

ReceiveRequest.description: Pull finished passes from a paired phone: by cable (USB) or Bluetooth LE.
ReceiveRequest.title: ReceiveRequest

SaveAssembly.description: An edited assembly (Construct editor, spec 0015) as a new version of an `assembly` object.
SaveAssembly.title: SaveAssembly

ScanMesh.description: All segment meshes of a pass, little-endian arrays as base64 (spec 0009).
ScanMesh.title: ScanMesh

ScanPassRef.description: One TrackScout pass the engine can open, identified by its SHA-256.
ScanPassRef.title: ScanPassRef

ScanTrack.description: Passes of one track (same coordinate frame): a workspace capture object or a project name.
ScanTrack.title: ScanTrack

ScheduleWindow.description: A weekly time window; ``end`` before ``start`` crosses midnight (days = start days).
ScheduleWindow.title: ScheduleWindow

SimControl.description: ``speed``: time factor for "speed", m/s for "teleop" (spec 0010, same JSON as the car).
SimControl.title: SimControl

SimProtocol.description: Documents the /api/v1/sim WebSocket messages so they appear in OpenAPI and the TS client.
SimProtocol.title: SimProtocol

TeamJobRequest.description: Run a training job on a team worker (spec 0020): exactly one of bench/tune/rl.
TeamJobRequest.title: TeamJobRequest

TrackScoutPairing.description: TrackScout pairing QR (spec 0007): server, new `trackscout` API token + laptop key.
TrackScoutPairing.title: TrackScoutPairing

TrainRLRequest.description: PPO training (spec 0022); the policy goes into a params YAML for onnx_policy.py.
TrainRLRequest.title: TrainRLRequest

TrainRace.description: Race settings shared by benchmark and tuning (held-out corridors from seed 1000).
TrainRace.title: TrainRace

WorkerPolicy.description: When this computer takes team jobs (spec 0020 part C).
WorkerPolicy.title: WorkerPolicy
